If this scope is ours and stays unpriced, the quote is roughly GBP 10,000 light.

requests.why: The enquiry spec is RAL 7016, triple glazed throughout, windows U 1.1. BSW replied that Smart Wall products are not available in triple glazing. The door system and the glazing spec cannot both be right, and any quote built before this is resolved is built on sand.

The missing panes are the A1 toplights across six window types, two door head panes, and all of Door Type C. No 32mm units are quoted anywhere. Separately, CN Glass quoted the same make-up at GBP 60/m2 versus Vetroseal's GBP 110/m2 - about GBP 7,000 difference on the full list.
